get.description: Requires an authenticated principal like every operation in this document. none reflects that a specification document carries no operator data, not that the request goes unauthenticated; an unauthenticated request is 401.

as_of.description: The server clock at the moment of the response. The client computes staleness from this, never from Date.now().

version.description: The monotonic snapshot generation. Absent when the payload is not config derived. This is the generation counter, not the bundle version, which is epoch-index.

next.description: The cursor for the following page, absent at the end.

total.description: The count at the moment of the call, documented as approximate because no cursor scheme can give an exact concurrent total.

message.description: Human readable; empty for an internal error; never a stack trace, a file path, a header value, a configuration value, or any part of a secret.

correlation_id.description: An alias of request_id, for the console's error block.

missing_permission.description: Present on every 403, drawn from x-it-permissions.

details.description: Bounded so one rejected document cannot return a diagnostic per line.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: An opaque continuation token; absent means the first page. Re-authorized on every use; never a plain serialized offset the caller can edit past an authorization boundary.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Page size. A well formed integer above 500 is clamped to 500; a malformed value is 400.

From.name: from
From.description: The start of the requested window, either a relative expression such as now-15m or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

To.name: to
To.description: The end of the requested window, either a relative expression such as now or an RFC 3339 timestamp.

Step.name: step
Step.description: The bucket width for getStatsTimeseries. Rounded up to the ring's resolution when finer; the response reports the step actually used.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The ETag of the resource last read by the caller. Required on every config mutating operation; a mismatch is 412.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: The ETag the caller already holds. A match answers 304 with no body.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A client chosen key deduplicating a retried mutation. A replay with a different body hash is 422.

Reason.name: X-IT-Reason
Reason.description: An operator supplied free text reason recorded in the audit log entry for this mutation.

Csrf.name: X-IT-CSRF
Csrf.description: The double submit CSRF token. Required on every mutating operation.

NoContent.description: The operation succeeded and there is no response body.

NotModified.description: The resource has not changed since the value named by If-None-Match.

BadRequest.description: The request was malformed or violated a documented bound.

Forbidden.description: The authenticated principal lacks the permission this operation requires. Identical whether or not the addressed resource exists.

NotFound.description: No resource exists at the addressed identifier. Only ever returned to a caller who already holds the operation's permission.

Conflict.description: The mutation conflicts with the current state of the resource.

PreconditionFailed.description: The If-Match value did not match the resource's current ETag.

Unprocessable.description: A replayed Idempotency-Key was reused with a different request body.

TooManyRequests.description: The caller or the process exceeded a concurrency or rate limit.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body exceeded the server's independent body size limit.

InternalError.description: An unexpected server error. message is always the empty string; correlate with request_id.

EventStream.description: A server sent event stream. The connection stays open until the client closes it.
